title: Isabella Bank Awards Development Grant to Community Auto & Tire Inc.
summary: Isabella Bank is proud to announce it has awarded grant funding to Community Auto & Tire Inc. through the Elevate Small Business Grant program (“Elevate”).
body_markdown:
Isabella Bank is proud to announce it has awarded grant funding to Community Auto & Tire Inc. through the Elevate Small Business Grant program (“Elevate”) administered by the Federal Home Loan Bank of Indianapolis (FHLBank Indianapolis). The funding will support facility improvements that help the business better serve customers, strengthen operations, and invest in its long-term future.


Located on Genesee Avenue in Saginaw, Community Auto & Tire Inc. will use the grant funds to make needed improvements to its facility, including installing a new heating system, replacing garage doors, and enhancing the property’s exterior. These upgrades will create a safer and more efficient workspace for employees, support day-to-day operations, and improve the appearance of the surrounding neighborhood.


“Isabella Bank is honored to partner with FHLBank Indianapolis in awarding the Elevate grant to Community Auto & Tire, Inc.” said David Brown, vice president and commercial lender at Isabella Bank. “Our shared mission is to help businesses access the resources they need to grow and succeed. Programs like Elevate help local businesses invest in growth, creating a ripple effect that strengthens our communities and supports long-term economic vitality. We are grateful for the opportunity to play a small role helping Community Auto & Tire access the resources they need to grow and succeed.”


Supporting local businesses and investing in the communities it serves are central to Isabella Bank’s mission. Through commercial lending, community development initiatives, charitable giving, sponsorships, and employee volunteerism, the Bank helps individuals, families, and businesses thrive while contributing to stronger economies across Michigan.


“The grant will help us maintain a welcoming, reliable tire shop for Saginaw families and strengthen the long-term future of our locally owned business,” Terry Reed, owner of Community Auto & Tire said. “With a better facility, we can continue providing affordable tire services while giving back through back-to-school giveaways, holiday drives, our annual Customer Appreciation Day, and other community outreach events.”


Elevate is available annually through participating member financial institutions of FHLBank Indianapolis. FHLBank Indianapolis does not award funds directly to small businesses; business owners who are interested in the program must work with a participating member financial institution to access grant funds. Eligible businesses must be headquartered in Indiana or Michigan, have been in continuous operation for at least one year and earn $1 million or less in annual gross revenue. Full program requirements can be found at[http://www.fhlbi.com/elevate](https://www.fhlbi.com/services/community-programs/small-business-grants/) . In 2026, FHLBank Indianapolis has committed more than $2 million for the program.


For more information about Elevate Small Business Grants, including the full list of 2026 recipients, please visit[http://www.fhlbi.com/elevate](https://www.fhlbi.com/services/community-programs/small-business-grants/) or contact one of Isabella Bank’s[commercial lenders](https://www.isabellabank.com/business/borrow/commercial-lending-team) .
